verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Qodo publishes an llms.txt at docs.qodo.ai (HTTP 200). It contains an agent-oriented summary of the product, so an agent can be pointed directly at it, which satisfies the story as written. Missing for 10: evidence of the file's depth and coverage (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
